newsitem.title: USA: Recoton Corp to consolidate German unit.
newsitem.headline: Recoton Corp to consolidate German unit.

text.p: Recoton Corp said on Wednesday that its subsidiary, Recoton Audio Corp, is consolidating its German audio operations, Magnat Audio Producte GmbH and MacAudio Electronic GmbH, in one centralized location, to be based near Cologne, Germany.
The company's press release did not indicate whether a charge would be taken for the consolidation, and a company spokeswoman was not immediately available.
The relocation of MacAudio facility from its present location in Delmenhorst, Germany, is expected to take place by the end of 1996.
Recoton Audio Corp is the new name of the former International Jensen Inc, a company which was acquired by Recoton on August 29, 1996.
